== Notes ==

* Like all spells, this skill has a {{3/4}} second [[aftercast delay]].
* Primary [[PvP-only character|PvP-only]] Assassins will be able to use this skill, even if it is not [[unlock]]ed on your account.
* Unlike other [[maintained enchantment]]s, [[hero]]es will use this skill on their own, but will not dismiss it or recast it once enchanted.
{{anomaly|Similar to other [[Enchantment spell#Characteristics|enchantments that target a foe]], foes affected by [[Well of the Profane]] or [[spirit]]s cannot be targeted by this enchantment.}}
